meta.name: understand-onboard
meta.description: Use when you need to generate an onboarding guide for new team members joining a project

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为新成员生成项目入职指南
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要快速帮助新成员了解项目
copy.tagline_en: Generate onboarding guides for new team members
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs to quickly help new members get up to speed

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会读取项目的知识图谱，生成一份新成员入职指南，包含项目概览、架构分层、关键概念、导览、文件地图和复杂度热点。
howto.when: 当用户要求为项目新成员生成入职指南时触发。需要先运行 /understand 命令生成知识图谱文件。

say.text: 为这个项目生成一份新成员入职指南。
say.note: Claude 会读取知识图谱并输出指南。

say.text: 帮我创建项目的 onboarding 文档。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reads the project's knowledge graph and generates an onboarding guide for new team members, including project overview, architecture layers, key concepts, guided tour, file map, and complexity hotspots.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to generate an onboarding guide for new team members. Requires the knowledge graph file to exist (generated by /understand command).

say_en.text: Generate an onboarding guide for this project.
say_en.note: Claude reads the knowledge graph and outputs the guide.

say_en.text: Create an onboarding document for the project.
say_en.note: Claude generates the guide and offers to save it to docs/ONBOARDING.md.
